name: init
brief: Initialize ThorVG WASM module and rendering engine.
description: This is the entry point for using ThorVG WebCanvas. It loads the WebAssembly module and initializes the rendering engine with the specified backend (Software, WebGL, or WebGPU).
warnings: {Error} If WASM module fails to load or engine initialization fails

members.name: init
members.brief: Initialize ThorVG WASM module and rendering engine.
description: This is the entry point for using ThorVG WebCanvas. It loads the WebAssembly module and initializes the rendering engine with the specified backend (Software, WebGL, or WebGPU).

params.name: options.locateFile
params.description: Optional function to locate WASM files. If not provided, assumes                              WASM files are in the same directory as the JavaScript bundle.

params.name: options.renderer
params.description: Renderer type: 'sw' (Software), 'gl' (WebGL), or 'wg' (WebGPU).                           Default: 'gl'. WebGPU provides best performance but requires                           Chrome 113+ or Edge 113+.

params.name: options.threads
params.description: Number of worker threads. Only effective with the thread preset.                          Ignored in the default preset. Default: 0 (single-threaded).

members.returns: Promise that resolves to ThorVG namespace containing all classes and utilities
warnings: {Error} If WASM module fails to load or engine initialization fails
